Overall, Verato is developing secure, cross enterprise data matching and linking technologies.

overview_description.description: Verato is a cloud-based patient matching technology that is better, faster, and cheaper than today's standard matching technologies.  We use a highly-curated, continuously-updated, self-learning database of identities and identity attributes spanning the entire U.S. adult population.  This database acts as an “answer key” for identity data.  We call this "referential matching."  Verato uses this database as an answer key during matching to make matches no other approach can ever make—even if two records have out-of-date, errored, incomplete, and inconsistent identity data.  Because of this approach, our match rates are the highest in the industry.  We deliver sub-second performance and can securely handle hundreds of millions of transactions to support the largest organizations.  Since, Verato is cloud-based, there is no software to deploy, support, and maintain.  We deliver quick time-to-value (weeks, not months or years) and a lower total cost of ownership than any of the on-premises solutions being used today. Better, cheaper, faster.

product.name: Verato MDM Cloud™
product.description: A cloud-based master data management platform that connects, resolves, enriches, governs, and activates identity data for people, organizations, and relationships.

product.name: Verato hMDM® for Healthcare
product.description: A healthcare-focused master data management platform that combines patient and provider identity resolution, data enrichment, stewardship, and interoperability capabilities.

product.name: Verato Provider Identity Intelligence
product.description: A provider identity and network data solution for resolving clinician and facility records, affiliations, attributes, and relationships across healthcare ecosystems.

product.name: Verato Auto Steward®
product.description: An AI-assisted data stewardship capability that prioritizes and automates identity-data review, duplicate resolution, and governance tasks.

product.name: Verato Verify™
product.description: A real-time digital identity verification service that verifies individuals through a secure identity-proofing workflow for access and identity-sensitive processes.

product.name: Verato Healthcare Data Connectors
product.description: Connectors and integration capabilities for ingesting and distributing healthcare identity data through EHR, HL7, FHIR, API, and batch interfaces.
